fieldValues.title: The bug fixer holds a builder seat in every group
fieldValues.decision_question: Who fixes bugs, and under whose rules?
fieldValues.context:
Problem: bugs ride their own queue (never the Ready feed), and their only consumer was a cloud routine whose rules lived in its own trigger prompt, outside the clerk. It claimed by adding a label, ran feature pipelines, and on 2026-10-21/22 built srs-web#595 three times and overwrote its description.
Why it matters: work outside the agreed process is work the process cannot see or govern (SP-62); a bug fix in a group's repos should get that group's review and count against its budget like any other group PR.
Compass: Human layer over agent suggestion, within a delegated mandate (the seat is the mandate); Reviewable units over throughput (one bug per run, quorum review). Mode: clear. Door: non-normative.
Recommendation: ratify; the owner already asked for it (2026-10-22: a separate routine, managed by the clerk, with a seat in each group).
Action needed: ratify in a session.
fieldValues.friction: Without a seat the bug fixer either bypasses clerk claim (and the srs-web#595 duplicates come back) or cannot claim group bugs at all.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
(a) Do nothing: the old routine stays paused and bugs wait for whoever notices them.
(b) Each group's own builder takes its bugs first: one fewer routine, but bugs compete with the group's ranked work, which the bug track (#717) exists to avoid.
(c) A separate bug fixer with the builder seat in every group and in the central group, following routines/bug-fixer.md (chosen): one consumer of the bug queue, every fix claimed, reviewed and budgeted by the group it belongs to.
fieldValues.key_requirements: Bugs never compete with the Ready feed. Every bug fix is claimed through the clerk and reviewed by the group whose label it carries. The bug fixer never merges.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The bug fixer (agent:bug-fixer) holds the builder seat in every working group and in the central group, and works only the bug queue, by its brief in the clerk.
fieldValues.rationale: A seat is how the practice gives an agent a mandate: clerk claim checks it, the group's reviewer reviews its PRs and its merges count against the group's budget. Placing the bug fixer in every group keeps the bug track separate (#717) without taking it outside the groups' rules (f799b6bc: members act under the same rules; 4fca091f: the central group takes undelegated work).
fieldValues.revisit_when: A group's budget is regularly spent on bug fixes, or a bug needs a ruling more often than a fix.
fieldValues.next_steps: On ratification nothing further is needed: the seat is already recorded (agent record and its authorised-by links). The trigger runs routines/bug-fixer.md (clerk#151).
